CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prospecting_released(p_balance bigint, p_started timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with cap as (select greatest(0,p_balance/2) total),
 starter as (select total,least(total,greatest(500,ceil(total/10.0))) initial from cap)
 select (initial+floor((total-initial)*least(1,greatest(0,extract(epoch from (now()-p_started))/(12*3600)))))::bigint from starter;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prospecting_total_available(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with budget as (select * from public.icash_prospecting_budgets where account_id=p_account order by id desc limit 1),
 spend as (select coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' then greatest(0,o.charged_cents-coalesce(duplicate_coverage.covered_cents,0)) when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) amount
  from public.icash_operation_spend o left join public.icash_duplicate_discovery_coverage duplicate_coverage on duplicate_coverage.operation_key=o.operation_key and duplicate_coverage.account_id=o.account_id join budget b on b.id=o.prospecting_budget_id where o.account_id=p_account),
 pending as (select coalesce(sum(o.charge_cap_cents),0) amount from public.icash_operation_spend o
  where o.account_id=p_account and o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and
  (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)))
 select coalesce((select greatest(0,least(b.limit_cents-spend.amount,w.balance_cents-(b.baseline_cents-b.limit_cents)-pending.amount))::bigint
  from budget b join public.icash_wallets w on w.account_id=b.account_id cross join spend cross join pending),0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prospecting_available(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with budget as (select * from public.icash_prospecting_budgets where account_id=p_account order by id desc limit 1),
 usage as (select
  coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' and (o.prospecting_budget_id=b.id or (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null and o.settled_at>now()-interval '24 hours')) then greatest(0,o.charged_cents-coalesce(duplicate_coverage.covered_cents,0))
   when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)) then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) amount,
  coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' and o.prospecting_budget_id is not null and o.settled_at>now()-interval '24 hours' then greatest(0,o.charged_cents-coalesce(duplicate_coverage.covered_cents,0))
   when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)) then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) recent_amount,
  coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' and o.prospecting_budget_id is not null and o.settled_at>now()-interval '1 hour' then greatest(0,o.charged_cents-coalesce(duplicate_coverage.covered_cents,0))
   when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)) then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) hour_amount
  from public.icash_operation_spend o left join public.icash_duplicate_discovery_coverage duplicate_coverage on duplicate_coverage.operation_key=o.operation_key and duplicate_coverage.account_id=o.account_id cross join budget b where o.account_id=p_account)
 select coalesce((select greatest(0,least(
  public.icash_prospecting_total_available(p_account),
  public.icash_prospecting_released(b.baseline_cents,b.created_at)-usage.amount,
  b.limit_cents-usage.recent_amount,
  least(b.limit_cents,greatest(500,ceil(b.limit_cents/10.0)))-usage.hour_amount
 ))::bigint from budget b cross join usage),0);
$function$
